scope: Reuse and strengthen authored visual-semantic/candidate data for the referenced 347 rows and supplemental prose meanings; no generator/control/skill workflow changes.

priorities.P0: 100 source rows: relations, structural confusions and visibility prerequisites that materially change the requested image.
priorities.P1: 199 source rows: local garment, material and surface distinctions; reuse current fit/construction meaning before adding records.
priorities.P2: 48 source rows: optional style families and color vocabulary; no class/personality/scene defaults.

work_waves.title: 반영 기준 재확인과 동등성 판정
actions: Recheck current HEAD, authored source bytes, dirty work and registered inventory; the research snapshot includes uncommitted sources.
Use a suitable isolated implementation checkout when source changes begin, preserving unrelated primary work.
Resolve every term's candidate/profile neighbors by actual owner, components, conditions and complete effects; do not convert lexical hit counts into coverage claims.
For new or product-overlapping names, record a claim-specific product/pattern source and exact definition before promotion.
work_waves.deliverable: Reviewed term decision table: reuse / equivalent alias / richer components / separate variant / metadata-only / unresolved source claim.
work_waves.acceptance: All changed record IDs and reused meanings are explicit. Original variants and historical evidence remain intact.

work_waves.title: 가장 영향 큰 레이어·커버리지 관계
actions: Reuse pfe_navel, pfe_lateral_chest, pfe_lower_chest and pfe_garter_path where full meaning remains equivalent; preserve their exact eligibility and claim limits.
Separate garment existence, topology, current fastening, outer/inner layer order and visible body region.
Author concrete same-owner relations and exact per-variant affected dimensions/properties; keep changing carrier domains subject to the same wardrobe locks.
Encode the actual selected alternative; family names never demand all alternatives.
work_waves.deliverable: Reviewed relation candidates and only definition-essential visual profiles.
work_waves.acceptance: Crop/low-rise/mini/halter/sheer keywords alone do not create an unsupported body-visibility assertion.

work_waves.title: 가을 겉옷·니트의 남은 구조 변형
actions: Compare Balmacaan to existing raglan records; compare Duffle to closure/hood/pocket structures.
Use independent matching cardigan/inner-knit entities for twinset and fastening-state fields for one-button cardigan.
Distinguish quilting seams from diamond print, eyelet knit from lace/mesh, and smocking stitching from shirring rows.
Existing entries take equivalent aliases or authored-components improvements; only unmatched concrete variants need new entries.
work_waves.deliverable: Minimal residual structure extensions; no broad pose or wardrobe recipes.
work_waves.acceptance: Every added name has source-specific boundaries and each selected relation exposes both concrete endpoints.

work_waves.title: 소재·표면·문양·색의 증거 분리
actions: Preserve fiber identity, exact DEN, manufacturing technique and numeric specifications as sourced metadata.
Author separate visible nap, pile, loop, color, pattern, reflectance and transmission proxies.
Use Rowan for intarsia technique; keep the observed Johnstons mismatch out of positive definitions.
Review proposed shaft_height/velvet_pile paths and other unobserved paths against current property-lock contracts before adopting names.
work_waves.deliverable: Material/style vocabulary with conservative pixel duties and exact source limits.
work_waves.acceptance: No metadata or hidden manufacturing claim is certified by a convenient visual proxy.

work_waves.title: 스타일군과 긍정 검색 표현 보강
actions: Keep classic/preppy/Ivy/trad and boho/western/goth/dark-romantic boundaries contextual.
Keep Korean/English equivalents, same-owner paraphrases and optional concrete wardrobe choices in positive fields.
Do not index contrast prose, unsupported hidden claims, source descriptions or limitations as positive meaning.
A selected multi-garment candidate is a whole optional contract with complete effects; it is not a keyword-to-fixed-scene recipe.
Style adjectives do not add people, occupations, age, nationality, social class, books, animals, vehicles, locations, lighting or lenses.
work_waves.deliverable: Scoped candidate variants and equivalent lexical extensions; no topic-specific control logic.
work_waves.acceptance: Optional candidate/profile exposure does not become automatic hard activation or retroactive pre-core authority.

work_waves.title: 원본 등록과 파생 색인 재생성
actions: Prefer photo_prompt_clothing_structure_extension.json and the matching visual source, photo_prompt_fashion_fit_extension.json, portrait exposure and existing material/style extensions where meaning is equivalent.
Only if separate residual data are justified, add photo_prompt_autumn_fashion_extension.json and photo_prompt_visual_obligations_autumn_fashion.json through photo_prompt_source_manifest.json.
Use source profiles' authored_components/v1 or v2; omit generated component_semantics, evidence_requirements, required_evidence_fields, render_gates and composition_instruction from source profiles.
Rebuild semantic dictionary/BM25F derivations and visual registry/index manifests whenever their bound source changes, including alias-only changes.
Reuse vectors only for identical full text/provider/model/dimensions/key; embed changed text under current supported batch rules.
Use the current cooperative source update and runtime publisher; stale or pending sources do not borrow an old generation to appear successful.
work_waves.deliverable: Validated authored sources, fresh indexes and exact immutable runtime generation/receipt.
work_waves.acceptance: Dictionary/registry/index/source hashes agree; index presence and runtime exposure are reported separately.

work_waves.title: 변경 범위별 회귀와 요청된 이미지 검증
actions: Run dictionary and visual-index validation and the affected current test modules; add only meaningful regression cases for new semantics or invariants.
Execute the 56 minimal pairs and 12 mutation scenarios with independently frozen request/core inputs; review eligible candidate meaning, activation, optional selection and final evidence separately.
Use full test discovery when multiple source registrations, compiled contracts or broad corpus changes justify it.
Image validation is a later separately requested phase. Run 12 native-image groups and the 12 original outfit holdouts with exact V6 pack/receipt/composed/runtime bindings.
Record technical binding, runtime exposure, complete native-pixel gates, whole-image reading and requester judgement as separate results.
work_waves.deliverable: Change-scoped regression evidence and, when requested, independently qualified images.
work_waves.acceptance: All required selected native gates must pass; partial/hidden evidence is not PASS. Provider blocks remain unscored.

separate_evidence_layers: saved native pixels and every active gate
no_entry_count_estimate: 129 research phrases are comparison/reuse/new-variant proposals, not 129 committed new runtime entries. Exact count follows W0 semantic review.
